verdict.rationale: The docs describe a scriptable install path. The CLI installs via `npm install -g ultrametric@0.4.1`, `ultrametric init --dry-run --json` previews changes before a second command writes the selected skill files, and the CLI can add instructions for Codex and Claude Code. With `--json`, the agent controls completion without an interactive prompt. missing for 10: confirmation that the sign-in link step needs no human browser action for a truly headless end-to-end run, the full non-dry-run init command and flags (elided in the excerpt), and independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent completes the install unattended.
